_meta.purpose: Bias and fairness test cases for NeoTriage's classification logic (mcp/tools/imnci_lookup.py + rule_engine.py). This is a rule-based clinical system, not a trained ML model, so testing focuses on: (1) confirming no demographic/identity attribute ever influences classification, (2) determinism, (3) fairness of the source-based confidence weighting (asha_reported vs parent_reported), and (4) consistency at rule boundary conditions.
_meta.scope_limitation: This test suite covers the classification logic only (mcp/tools/). It does NOT cover potential bias in the ASR layer (accent/dialect recognition accuracy across languages/regions -- Soham's asr/transcribe.py) or the disambiguation question-answering layer (Shreeja's agents/disambiguation/) -- those are separate, real bias surfaces owned by other components and flagged as out of scope here, not resolved.

demographic_neutrality_check.description: Confirms danger_signs.json contains no field that encodes gender, caste, religion, name, region, language, or any other identity/demographic attribute. The classification logic can only ever see clinical signs.
demographic_neutrality_check.method: Static scan of all keys in data/imnci_rules/danger_signs.json against a list of prohibited attribute categories.

determinism_cases.description: Same input run 20 times should produce byte-identical output every time -- no hidden randomness in classification.

source_fairness_cases.description: Identical dangerous signs, only source differs. Expect IDENTICAL urgency for both -- refer_now should never depend on who reported it, since urgent danger signs override any confidence weighting.
source_fairness_cases.expected: highest_urgency must be identical (refer_now) regardless of source

source_fairness_cases.description: Identical fully-covered healthy signs, only source differs. Expect IDENTICAL urgency (reassure) for both -- confirms the post-fix margin doesn't penalize parent-reported input when coverage is genuinely complete.
source_fairness_cases.expected: highest_urgency must be identical (reassure) regardless of source

source_fairness_cases.description: Identical PARTIALLY-covered signs, only source differs. Expect asha_reported to trust the reassure classification, while parent_reported gets the wider margin (monitor_recheck) -- this IS an intentional, documented differential treatment, not an unfair one, since it exists specifically to compensate for lower-structure voice input. Confirms the differential only ever moves toward MORE caution for parent_reported, never less.
source_fairness_cases.expected: asha_reported should NOT bump; parent_reported SHOULD bump. Direction of difference must always favor caution for parent_reported, never the reverse.

boundary_consistency_cases.description: Fast breathing at age 6 days (just under the 7-day cutoff) must classify as severe, not local.
Fast breathing at exactly age 7 days must classify as local, not severe -- confirms the boundary itself (not just values away from it) is handled correctly.
Fast breathing at age 59 days (top of local-infection range) must still classify as local.
Jaundice present at age 13 days must NOT trigger the severe age-based escalation.
Jaundice present at exactly age 14 days MUST trigger the severe age-based escalation -- this is the exact boundary Shreeja's clinical review flagged.
Pustule severity: few_localized must stay monitor_recheck, ten_or_more_or_big_boil must escalate to refer_now -- confirms no silent inconsistency between adjacent severity tiers.
